title: Kernel benchmark service
responsibility: Measures cold and warm latency, throughput, and available memory for the configured module, Wasm, process, and HTTP kernel runtimes.

inputs.name: KernelBenchmarkService.constructor.plan
inputs.description: CLI command vector used to launch fresh-process samples and the HTTP server, plus the cold sample and warm iteration counts. The service uses coldSamples for fresh-process calls and warmIterations for calls on initialized runtimes without validating the counts.

inputs.name: KernelBenchmarkService.constructor.context
inputs.description: Measurement context passed to benchMeasurement for each recorded result. This service does not inspect or validate its fields.

inputs.name: KernelBenchmarkService.measure.run
inputs.description: Workload id, node count, seed, and runtime request used by the measurement loop. The service uses nodes and seed for fresh-process samples and uses id and request for the measurements without checking their consistency.

inputs.name: KernelBenchmarkService.measure.url
inputs.description: Server URL supplied to the HTTP runtime and cold HTTP samples. The service uses it only for the http target and does not start the server here.

inputs.name: KernelBenchmarkService.describe.run
inputs.description: Workload run whose id, node count, and request dimensions are summarized. The request input is assumed to contain array-valued base.edges and changed fields; byte counts use UTF-8 lengths of serialized request and impactKernel response.

inputs.name: serveKernel.cli
inputs.description: CLI command vector whose first string is passed to spawn and whose remaining strings precede kernel serve --port 0 --runtime module. The vector must contain an executable command; the function does not validate it first.

inputs.name: serveKernel.startupTimeoutMs
inputs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds for readiness output. It defaults to 20000 and is passed to setTimeout without range validation.

outputs.name: KernelBenchmarkService.measure
outputs.description: Resolved array containing cold latency, warm latency, throughput, and memory measurements for module, wasm, process, and http runtimes. Each successful call returns 16 entries, and memory may carry an unavailable reason when it cannot be attributed.

examples.method: Median of 5 fresh-process samples: create the runtime, serialize the request, invoke once and parse the response. CLI startup is excluded because every runtime pays it.
Median of 100 calls on an initialized runtime, including request serialization and response parsing.

Not measured.
examples.unavailable: In-process module memory cannot be attributed to one unit.

outputs.name: KernelBenchmarkService.describe
outputs.description: Workload summary containing the run id and node count, edge and changed counts from request.input, and UTF-8 byte lengths of serialized request and impactKernel response. The implementation assumes request.input.base.edges and request.input.changed are arrays.

outputs.name: serveKernel
outputs.description: Resolves after the child emits its first stdout chunk containing JSON with a string url, returning that URL and a stop function that calls child.kill(). Startup timeout, early exit, or invalid readiness data rejects the promise.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown through fail when the native kernel artifact is absent or a cold sample exits with a nonzero code. A cold sample failure includes its stderr.

errors.name: Kernel server startup failure
errors.description: Rejected when spawning fails, the startup timeout elapses, the child exits before readiness, or the first stdout chunk is not JSON containing a string url. Timeout, early-exit, and invalid-readiness cases reject with Error.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: serveKernel rejects with Error when child spawning fails, startup times out, the child exits before readiness, or its first stdout chunk is invalid JSON or contains a non-string url.
